annotations.title: Verify a Google Business Profile listing

description: VERIFICATION of a Google Business Profile listing — the last step before a new listing shows on Maps, and what lets its edits go live. action "state" (default): verified or not, a pending verification, Google review, suspension, plus every past verification. action "options": the methods Google offers THIS listing (postcard, phone call, text, email, automatic) with the exact numbers / addresses it would use — sends nothing. A service-area business (no storefront) must pass context.address (its mailing address). action "start": method (ADDRESS, EMAIL, PHONE_CALL, SMS, AUTO, TRUSTED_PARTNER) plus phoneNumber or emailAddress picked from options (mailerContact for a postcard) — IT REACHES THE BUSINESS (Google mails, calls, texts or emails it), so call it without confirm first (it says exactly what will be sent and sends nothing) and then confirm:true. action "complete": verificationId (from state) + pin (the code Google sent). 0 credits.

confirm.description: start: true ONLY after the user agreed Google may contact the business this way

context.description: options/start for a service-area business: {address:{regionCode, postalCode, administrativeArea, locality, addressLines}}

emailAddress.description: start EMAIL: an address from options

languageCode.description: options/start: BCP 47 language of the verification (default en)

locationId.description: which listing (locations/…), from list_business_locations — only needed when more than one is shared with this profile

mailerContact.description: start ADDRESS: the name the postcard is addressed to

method.description: start: one of the methods options returned

phoneNumber.description: start PHONE_CALL/SMS: a number from options

verificationId.description: complete: the pending verification’s id, from state
